Introduction

More than land — a promise of security and belonging.

At Suraksha Enclave Jattari, Tappal Bajna Urban Centre; every plot is more than just land — it is a promise of security, belonging, and a future built with pride. Envisioned for India's paramilitary families and a few privileged civilians, Suraksha Enclave brings together Govt. approved township living, thoughtful planning, and the confidence of tomorrow near the rapidly growing Jewar–Tappal region.
